title: Sanitized collection GET followed by PUT can erase hidden private membership
detail: Static review observed GET /knowledge/collections omits private/unavailable member IDs and disables UI editing, while the prior concrete writeCollection boundary accepted replacement with only visible members or an empty array at the current revision, allowing a direct API client to erase withheld curation. No executed original RED run exists.
reproduction_setup: Use actual authenticated createServer with concrete createMongoKnowledgeStore over a filter-enforcing Mongo-like fixture. Tenant a has safe recording session shared, raw whatsapp-batch session wa-session and mixed-source speaker mixed-speaker. Seed tenant-a collection _id='a'.repeat(64), title='Saved curation', revision=1, updatedAt='2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z', members=[{kind:'session',id:'shared'},{kind:'speaker',id:'mixed-speaker'},{kind:'session',id:'wa-session'}]. Clone the entire stored row. GET /knowledge/collections must omit mixed-speaker and wa-session, return only shared with available:true, and unavailableMembers:true.

reproductions.case: GET sanitized visible members -> PUT safe subset
reproductions.expected: 409; complete stored collection equals original clone, including all three members, revision and updatedAt.

reproductions.case: GET sanitized members -> PUT empty members
reproductions.expected: 409; complete stored collection equals original clone, including all three members, revision and updatedAt.

control.case: Fully visible collection update remains supported and targeted
control.setup: Create one tenant-a collection with only safe session shared and a safe sibling collection. Update the first at expectedRevision1 using authorized visible members.
control.expected: 200; target revision becomes2 with exact requested membership/title, sibling remains unchanged, every concrete predicate remains tenant-scoped.

fix_direction: Before replacing members, concrete writeCollection must load authenticated tenant+_id+expectedRevision current row and refuse the update if any current stored member is unavailable. UI-only restriction is insufficient. Full intentional collection DELETE remains separate.
measurement: Required ledger floor: A and B replayed verbatim against actual mounted API/concrete store; report ISS-T055COLLECTIONS-001 0/2 unexecuted until a fresh CPU-broker grant. Control C is additional required behavior, not a substituted corpus.
